description: Compares the same product (price, delivered cost) across TikTok Shop, Amazon, Etsy, eBay and an own online store in one country, with the verdict and net kept per sale on each channel.

channel.description: Where it is sold: tiktok (TikTok Shop), amazon, etsy, ebay, boutique (own store, e.g. Shopify), physique (in person), autre (other).

cost.description: Delivered cost per unit: product + packaging + shipping to the customer.

country.description: Store country: FR, BE, DE, ES, IT, IE, UE (other EU), UK, US, XX (other). Sets currency, VAT and default fees.

delivery_days.description: Business days from order to delivery (optional, used for the verdict).

fixed_fee_per_order.description: Override the fixed fee per order.

price.description: Selling price paid by the customer, tax included (e.g. 24.90).

samples_percent.description: Free samples as % of units sold.

shipping_charged.description: Shipping paid by the customer, if any.

ships_from.description: Where parcels ship from (matters for TikTok Shop in the EU).

social_contributions_percent.description: Social contributions and taxes as % of revenue (France micro-entreprise default 12.3).

starting_budget.description: Starting budget available for stock, ads and samples: returns the max and suggested number of units (30% kept for ads and surprises).

stock_quantity.description: Units in the first stock order (default 50).

vat_percent.description: VAT rate % (default: standard rate of the country; 0 for VAT exemption).

name: compare_channels
title: Manifeste: compare sales channels
